title: Do carbs at night make you fat? 🌙🍚
caption:
Fat gain comes from eating more than you burn over days and weeks, not from the clock. In one study, eating most carbs at dinner even led to slightly more weight loss. The real problem is extra late snacking. Night carbs: yes or no? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Diet & Food #2
first_comment: Midnight rice gang, you are safe 😌🍚
sources: Sofer S et al. Greater weight loss and hormonal changes after 6 months diet with carbohydrates eaten mostly at dinner. Obesity 2011;19:2006-2014
Kinsey AW, Ormsbee MJ. The health impact of nighttime eating: old and new perspectives. Nutrients 2015;7:2648-2662
